feature.title: Message forms and process states catalogue

purpose: Validate and index the exact 45 source-declared Message state and form records into an immutable provenance catalogue without inferring scientific hierarchy, transitions, or validity.

required.statement: Accept exactly the 45 authoritative object identifiers listed by this contract, each once with its source reference.
Group records by recorded source section and subsection and preserve recorded source order within each context.
Return complete lookup indexes by object identifier and source context with every record retrievable.
Preserve all identities, opaque payloads, source references, candidate status, provenance, and all 42 unresolved identifiers.

forbidden.statement: Do not infer hierarchy, classification, medium semantics, transitions, application validity, truth, or scientific order between contexts.
Do not merge records, accept unknown identifiers, tolerate duplicates, omit required records, or promote candidate status.
Do not define protocol, transport, execution, timing, or numerical behavior.
Do not expose a successful partial catalogue after any validation or preservation failure.

deferred.statement: Scientific classification, hierarchy, medium semantics, temporal transitions, and application validity remain preserved unresolved.
Index structures, grouping and ordering algorithms, ownership, storage, concurrency, and serialization remain implementation-defined.

operations.purpose: Build the complete identifier and source-context catalogue for the authoritative 45-record population.

inputs.name: message_state_records
inputs.semantic_role: exact Message state and form record population

fields.name: recorded_source_order
fields.semantic_role: order within the recorded source context

constraints.statement: Every authoritative identifier occurs exactly once and no unknown identifier occurs.
Each record carries its authoritative source context and recorded source position.
Incidental input sequence order is not scientific order; recorded source positions govern context ordering.

outputs.name: message_state_catalogue
outputs.semantic_role: immutable complete Message forms and states catalogue

fields.name: identifier_index
fields.semantic_role: complete exact lookup by object identity

fields.name: context_index
fields.semantic_role: complete lookup by source section and subsection

constraints.statement: Exactly 45 distinct records are present and each is retrievable through the identifier index.
Every record is retrievable through its exact source context and records inside each context follow recorded source order.
No hierarchy, transition, classification, or status promotion is introduced.
All 42 unresolved identifiers, opaque values, source references, and provenance are preserved.

preconditions.statement: The input population equals the authoritative 45-identifier set exactly.
Each identifier occurs once and every record has its authoritative source reference and recorded source position.

postconditions.statement: All 45 records are retrievable by exact identifier and source context.
No record is merged, reordered within its source context, omitted, or promoted from candidate status.
The 42 unresolved identifiers and all provenance remain observable.

invariants.statement: Identity, content, source context, recorded order within context, provenance, candidate status, and unresolved state are conserved.
No scientific hierarchy, transition, validity decision, execution, or external state mutation occurs.

steps: build complete identifier and context indexes

partial_order.before: build complete identifier and context indexes

prescription_basis: Exact population, complete indexes, recorded context order, preservation, and failure-before-success are observable. Grouping, sorting, and indexing techniques are not prescribed.

error_contract.condition: One or more authoritative identifiers or required source references are absent.
An authoritative object identifier occurs more than once.
An object identifier outside the exact authoritative set is supplied.

implementation_modes.statement: Expose complete 45-record coverage and both exact indexes.
Do not infer classification, hierarchy, validity, or transition semantics.
Do not expose protocol, transport, or execution behavior.
Any grouping and index architecture is allowed when all observable obligations remain satisfied.

global_invariants.statement: The exact 45-object population and 42 unresolved identifiers remain complete and distinct.
Recorded source order is normative only within source contexts; no order or hierarchy between contexts is inferred.

dependencies.purpose: Exact population and ordered context collections.

notes: The documentary dependency on TLC-FC-07-MESSAGE-006 does not create an execution dependency.
